title: R07 Small-Batch Shapes and Reject/Accept Criteria
description: Definition-time projection shape fixtures for batch sizes b in [1, 2, 3, 4, 6] under real quantization formats (PQ2_0, Q5_K, F16 KV), establishing reject/accept notes, 128-element block alignment, and weight-tile sharing rules without online autotune.

quantization_block_invariants.weight_tile_sharing_rule: For batch sizes b in [2, 6], threads within workgroups must reuse loaded and unpacked weight tiles across concurrent batch rows rather than decoding weights independently per row.

shape_fixtures.notes: Existing single-row fast path. Baseline for latency and regression tracking. Does not trigger multi-row weight tile sharing.
Target primary candidate for shared weight tile. Two active input rows reuse the same PQ2_0 decoded weight tile (128 elements per block), halving weight VRAM bandwidth demand.
Odd batch size. Evaluates 2-row shared tile plus 1-row masked tail or specialized b=3 kernel. Must verify inactive/tail row does not cause out-of-bounds memory access or poison valid outputs.
Target high-efficiency candidate. Four concurrent rows consume the identical weight tile, matching LateBind row capacity tile VK_TP5_DIRECT_COLUMN_TILE=4.
Supported upper bound for operator recipe (b=6). Note: b=6 projection recipe support does not automatically expand LateBind HC capacity (which remains 4).
Batch size 7 exceeds multi-row projection recipe maximum; must deterministically reject to fallback general GEMM rather than hanging or clipping.
K dimension (2550) is not an exact multiple of the PQ2_0 128-element block size; rejected to prevent partial-block corruption.

rejection_matrix.UNSUPPORTED_BATCH_SIZE_EXCEEDS_6: Batch size b > 6 rejected by supports_op.
rejection_matrix.UNALIGNED_K_NOT_MULTIPLE_OF_128: K dimension not divisible by 128 PQ2_0 block element count.
rejection_matrix.UNSUPPORTED_QUANT_TYPE: Quantization format other than validated PQ2_0, Q5_K, or FP16.
rejection_matrix.LATEBIND_CAPACITY_INDEPENDENCE: b=6 recipe acceptance is local to projection operator; does not override LateBind direct column tile limit.
